title: Cokret Invite Receive Policy
description: Subject-private policy used by a Principal Server to decide which invite delivery introduction evidence may notify the holder. This policy is not written into the target Realm durable event log.

subject_id.description: Principal DID whose private invite receive policy this object configures. v1 core defaults principal DIDs to did:webvh; did:web is only valid for principal identity when an explicit deployment profile or resolver policy allows it.

allowed_introduction_kinds.description: Allowlist of introduction evidence kinds that may reach holder notification or review.

explicit_address_behavior.description: Default behavior for explicit_address evidence. Deployments SHOULD default to quarantine or drop, not notify.

unknown_invites.description: Behavior for delivery requests without compliant introduction_evidence.
